name: gitlab-pipeline-watch
description: Watch GitLab MR pipelines and react to state changes

interface.shortDescription: Watch GitLab MR pipelines and react to state changes.
interface.longDescription: Blocks until a GitLab MR pipeline reaches an actionable state — success, failure, merge, or a new MR being created — then reacts accordingly. Designed for event-loop workflows where the agent needs to wait for CI results before taking the next step. Requires the glab CLI and Python 3.7+. Use this skill when you want the agent to pause and respond automatically to pipeline state changes rather than polling manually.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the gitlab-pipeline-watch skill for this task.
